name: Mayhem

date.source: The fed’s own rumours page, 12 December 2002, refers to a CEO of Operations who wrestled “in a tag match on the debut Mayhem” and then disappeared (promotions/nticw/archive/rumours-2002-12.html).

evidence.note: The fed’s own in-fiction news names its debut Mayhem and a tag match on it; no card or results page for the show was ever captured.

notes: The fed's own December 2002 rumours page frames this show's own aftermath — a tag match Peter Degennaro wrestled on it, then his disappearance — as unfolding drama alongside Cade Johnson's hospitalization and Chris Harmon's pending trial; kept as a tenure-level note on Peter Degennaro rather than an appearances row here, since a rumours page's own retrospective claim on an uncollected show is not a card billing.
